info.name: QA Portfolio Playground
info.description:
Postman collection for the QA Portfolio & Testing Playground API (CRUD on /api/test-items).

RUN ORDER (Collection Runner, keep folder order, run the whole collection):
00 Setup -> 01 Health -> 02 POST -> 03 GET -> 04 PUT -> 05 DELETE -> 06 Cleanup.

SAFETY:
- PUT and DELETE only target records created by this collection (activeItemId).
- nonExistentId is verified with GET before use and is never used for DELETE.
- Cleanup deletes only the IDs recorded by this run. There is no bulk delete.
- Re-runnable: IDs are cleared at the start of each run.

Environment variables: baseUrl, activeItemId, nonExistentId (+ runtime state: activeCreatedAt, activeUpdatedAt, minimalItemId, nullDescItemId).
